**[Get WhisperShortcut on the Mac App Store](https://whispershortcut.com/go/appstore?src=github-release)** — automatic updates, one-time purchase.

## German
- **The app now speaks German.** On a Mac set to German (or with WhisperShortcut set to German in System Settings → General → Language & Region) every menu, setting, popup and the onboarding appear in German. English stays the default everywhere else.
- **New Language section** in Settings → General shows the app language and opens the macOS language settings in one click.
- The in-app Chat knows the German labels, so asking "Wo schalte ich den Offline-Modus ein?" gets an answer with the names you see on screen.

## Meetings
- Long meetings with several speakers no longer lose their beginning when the meeting is wrapped up. The tidied transcript only replaces the original when it kept every timestamp.
- The last seconds of a meeting are no longer dropped when you press Stop right as a new chunk starts.
- An update prompt no longer pops up and steals focus while a meeting records. It appears once the meeting has finished.
- The meeting chat now opens with the meeting's title, date and an *Open notes* button instead of the general start screen.
- One copy control in the meeting bar: a click copies the transcript, the arrow offers the full export and *Show Transcript File in Finder*.

## Mail
- Mail with an inline image no longer loses the text after the image.
- German HTML mail shows umlauts instead of codes like `&uuml;`.
- Folders with spaces in their names are found, and large messages on a slow connection no longer time out mid-download.

## Fixes
- Re-deriving your writing style keeps the sections you wrote by hand.
- The sidebar opens the date group of the chat you are in, so the open row is always visible.
- Claude and other AI apps see your meeting titles in `list_meetings`.

## Installation
Download the DMG from the [releases page](https://github.com/mgsgde/whisper-shortcut/releases), open it, and drag WhisperShortcut to your Applications folder.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/mgsgde/whisper-shortcut/compare/v8.59...v8.60
